To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Tulsi leaf powder has the potential to reduce oxidative stress in broiler birds.
TLP supplementation significantly (P< 0.05) reduced alkaline phosphatases in broiler chicks.
Tulsi leaf powder supplementation in broiler diet at 0.5 and 1 percent levels significantly (P< 0.05) reduced the oxidative stress in broiler chicks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of dietary supplementation of Tulsi leaf powder on hematological parameters in broilers.
the effect of TLP as antioxidant on oxidative stress in broilers.
the effect of TLP on oxidative stress markers in broilers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TLP supplementation in feeds of broilers significantly (P< 0.05) lowered alkaline phosphatases activity and significantly (P<05) increased super oxide dismutase (SOD) activity in broilers.
Tulsi leaf powder supplementation to broilers diet at a level of 0.5 and 1.00 % significantly reduced the level of alkaline phosphatases.
Tulsi leaf powder supplementation in broiler feed has a positive effect on the antioxidant status of broilers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
TLP supplementation in broiler feeds at the level of 0.25% to 1.0 % can be used as a feed additive for improving the performance of the broiler birds.
the supplementation of 0.5 and 1.00% Tulsi leaf powder in broilers diet significantly (p<0.05 and 0.01 respectively) reduced the level of oxidative stress markers in broilers.
the TLP can be used as a feed supplement in broiler diets as it improves the hematological parameters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TLP supplementation at 0.25% and 0.5 % in feed can be used to reduce the oxidative stress in broilers.
the addition of Tulsi leaf powder in broilers feed can be used as a potential antioxidant to reduce oxidative stress in broiler birds.
the addition of TLP to the feed can be a useful dietary supplement to improve the oxidative stress in broilers and can be a useful alternative to synthetic antioxidants.
